upsert.title: Global Virtual Hackathon 2026
upsert.summary: Free online hackathon for school students aged 14-18 worldwide, run in age divisions with recorded team interviews. Registration closes 14 Nov 2026; project submissions due 26 Nov 2026.
upsert.eligibility: Students aged 14-18 enrolled in schools worldwide; parent or guardian consent and a supervising teacher required. No India restriction stated.

prize.description: US$1,000 cash for first place in each age division, plus two US$250 runner-up prizes per division.

notes: Details read from an aggregator detail page; the organiser's own site was not linked there.

upsert.title: AwardX International 26 (LaunchX)
upsert.summary: Virtual entrepreneurship pitch competition for high-school and university-aged students from any country. Top 10 finalists get Flagship Program scholarships; winners announced 17 Dec 2026.
upsert.eligibility: High-school and university-aged students from any country; individuals or teams.

prize.description: US$7,000 total cash funding including a US$5,000 equity-free grand prize; finalists also get LaunchX program scholarships (non-cash).

notes: Application deadline 14 Nov 2026; timezone not stated on the listing page, so the cutoff time is an assumption. Confirm on the LaunchX site.

upsert.title: ITU AI for Good Innovation Factory 2026
upsert.summary: Global startup pitch competition for early-stage AI startups with a working prototype or MVP. Online applications; pitch session planned 8 Dec 2026.
upsert.eligibility: Early-stage AI startups from any country; need a prototype/beta/MVP, at least 6 months of operation and under US$1M total funding raised.

prize.description: US$20,000 non-dilutive cash grand prize, plus mentorship and exposure (non-cash).

notes: Details from an aggregator page; deadline timezone not stated. Confirm on the official ITU / Seedstars page before applying.

upsert.title: IEEE Big Data Cup 2026: UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR

organizer.name: IEEE International Conference on Big Data

upsert.summary: Sim2Real LiDAR detection challenge (LUMPI and V2X-Real tracks) on Codabench, part of the IEEE Big Data 2026 Cup.
upsert.eligibility: Not stated on the Cup page; entry needs 50 synthetic frames, detections on 50 real frames and a signed honor declaration.

prize.description: US$2,000 pool; per-track awards of US$500 / US$300 / US$200.

notes: Final due 15 Nov 2026, timezone not stated. Challenge page: https://urbanity-lab.github.io/bdc2026-urbantwin-sim2real/ (not opened).
